A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the thermodynamics of the helix-coil equilibrium in synthetic polypeptides is well established, and that this equilibrium is of great significance for our understanding of the structure and function of biological macromolecules.
the helix--coil transition of polypeptides can be treated as a cooperative process, and the thermodynamic parameters of the process can be divided into energy and entropy components.
